verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at developers.zoom.us/llms.txt (HTTP 200), which links an API catalog and an MCP section. Scribe docs are served as markdown (e.g. scribe/.md, fast-mode.md, batch-mode.md, confirmed by probe), and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec for the Scribe endpoints is reachable. Together these give an agent clear entry points. Missing for 10: llms.txt is Zoom-wide and the truncated probe doesn't show Scribe-specific entries, and there's no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
